description: A narrow shopfront on the last dry corner of Ironside, painted a cheap green. The window is triple-glazed and barred: nine comics on nine little easels, each sleeved under its own lamp, none for sale. A card reads DO NOT TAP THE GLASS. The sign is gold on black, MINT CONDITION, and under it, COMICS · CARDS · TAPES · NO EXCEPTIONS.
name: Mint Condition
